run.question:
Alertmanager alert RequestErrorRate (severity warning) is firing for service otel-demo/frontend since 2026-11-16T15:59:51Z.
Investigate why this alert is firing.

report.summary: The RequestErrorRate warning for otel-demo/frontend is explained by the checkout workload being unusable. The only frontend spans carrying error status in the 48 minutes ending 16:17:51 are on the checkout path (POST /api/checkout, executing api route /api/checkout, grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder, 418.15 span-increases each), while cart, product, data and recommendation operations show zero error spans. This error rate was 0 until 15:59:51 and then rose to about 0.76 errors/s, and the checkout service's own PlaceOrder server spans fell from ~0.72/s to 0 during the same period. The single checkout pod, checkout-5dccddf8bb-9dn2q, is Running but not ready, in CrashLoopBackOff with 11 restarts and a last termination of reason Error / exitCode 2; its container spec image has been replaced with gcr.io/google-containers/pause:latest while the Deployment and ReplicaSet templates still specify ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-checkout, and the original image is preserved in the pod annotation checkout-normal. No other one of the 21 otel-demo pods carries the pause image or such an annotation. The checkout Service has only notReadyAddresses, so frontend has no reachable checkout endpoint, and the Deployment has been Available=False / MinimumReplicasUnavailable with a single replica. Checkout's dependencies (cart, currency, payment, email, shipping, product-catalog) show no error-status spans and their pods are ready with zero restarts, so a dependency fault is not supported.

claims.text: In the 48 minutes ending 16:17:51 the frontend's error-status span increases are confined to the checkout path: span_name POST /api/checkout = 418.15, executing api route (pages) /api/checkout = 418.15, grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder = 418.15 and POST = 418.15, while GET /api/cart, GET /api/data, POST /api/cart, grpc.oteldemo.CartService/GetCart, CartService/AddItem, AdService/GetAds, ProductCatalogService/GetProduct and RecommendationService/ListRecommendations all show 0 error-status increase.
Frontend span_name POST /api/checkout error-status rate was 0 from 15:37 through 15:57, first became non-zero (0.0556/s) at 15:59:51, and rose to about 0.72-0.76/s through the following samples.
The checkout service's oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder span rate fell from 0.7185/s at 15:57 and 0.5333/s at 15:59 to 0.2148/s at 16:03 and 0/s from 16:05 onward (metric samples end at 16:13).

Pod checkout-5dccddf8bb-9dn2q is phase Running but ready=false with restartCount 11; its container 'checkout' is in state waiting reason CrashLoopBackOff with message 'back-off 2m40s restarting failed container=checkout', and its lastState.terminated shows reason Error, exitCode 2, startedAt 16:05:39 and finishedAt 16:05:44.

The pod's container spec image is gcr.io/google-containers/pause:latest with pod annotation checkout-normal=ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-checkout, while the checkout Deployment's container image and the checkout-5dccddf8bb ReplicaSet's pod-template image remain ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-checkout.

Across all 21 otel-demo pods, checkout-5dccddf8bb-9dn2q is the only pod running gcr.io/google-containers/pause:latest and the only pod carrying a checkout-normal annotation; every other pod runs its ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-* image.

Pod events for checkout-5dccddf8bb-9dn2q include Killing 'Container checkout definition changed, will be restarted' (count 7, first 15:58:44, last 16:01:44), Pulled for image gcr.io/google-containers/pause:latest (count 6, 15:58:44-16:05:11) and Warning BackOff 'Back-off restarting failed container checkout' (count 26, 16:00:44-16:06:32).
The checkout Service's Endpoints object contains only a notReadyAddresses entry for pod checkout-5dccddf8bb-9dn2q (IP 100.96.4.26) on port 8080, i.e. no ready checkout endpoint.

Deployment checkout has replicas=1 and condition Available=False with reason MinimumReplicasUnavailable (lastTransitionTime 16:05:44) and unavailableReplicas=1, so the checkout workload has no second replica to absorb the failure.

Checkout application logs from 15:44:09 to 15:44:53 show normal successful order handling ('[PlaceOrder]', 'payment went through', 'order placed', 'order confirmation email sent', 'Successful to write message'), i.e. checkout was processing orders normally about 14 minutes before the alert started.

Over 15:29:51-16:17:51 the checkout service's dependency spans carry no error status: cart (POST /oteldemo.CartService/GetCart, AddItem, EmptyCart, HGET/HMSET/EXPIRE), currency Currency/Convert is STATUS_CODE_OK, payment charge and grpc.oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge, email send_email, shipping /get-quote and /ship-order, and product-catalog GetProduct/ListProducts all appear only with STATUS_CODE_UNSET or OK and no STATUS_CODE_ERROR series.

All other otel-demo pods (accounting, ad, cart, currency, email, flagd, fraud-detection, frontend, frontend-proxy, image-provider, kafka, load-generator, otel-collector, payment, postgresql, product-catalog, quote, recommendation, shipping, valkey-cart) are Running and ready with 0 restarts; the frontend pod frontend-675fd7b5c5-gc9hg is Running, ready=true, restarts=0.

frontend-proxy shows its own error-status spans that start with the same onset: 'router frontend egress' error rate is 0 through 15:57, 0.185/s at 15:59:51 and peaks around 0.74-0.77/s, and 'ingress' rises from a ~0.01/s pre-incident baseline to ~0.78/s in the same samples.

Over 15:59-16:13 frontend as a whole recorded 1731.68 error-status span increase against 31685.85 non-error (STATUS_CODE_UNSET) span increase, confirming a non-trivial error share on the service named in the alert.

The fault originates in pod checkout-5dccddf8bb-9dn2q: its container image was replaced in-place with gcr.io/google-containers/pause:latest (original image retained in the checkout-normal annotation), the kubelet repeatedly reported 'Container checkout definition changed, will be restarted' from 15:58:44, the container then crash-looped (CrashLoopBackOff, 11 restarts, last exit code 2), the checkout Service lost all ready endpoints, and frontend's PlaceOrder calls therefore failed from 15:59:51 onward, producing the RequestErrorRate alert.

The pod's containerStatuses entry reports image ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-checkout with imageID ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo@sha256:f000c1de37175546a22846714e1c11a19bc2997e8769bb7bffcab5c4c10c24b2 for the last terminated attempt, which is inconsistent with the pause:latest image in the pod spec; the image mutation is therefore established from the pod spec and the 'definition changed' / pause-image events, not from the last container's reported image, so the exact image of the final crash is not fully pinned down.

A checkout dependency failure (cart, currency, payment, email, shipping, product-catalog, kafka) is not supported: their spans show no error status and their pods are ready with 0 restarts, and checkout handled orders successfully until ~15:44 before the pod-level change at 15:58.

A frontend application fault is not supported: the frontend pod is Running/ready with 0 restarts, its non-checkout operations (GET /, /api/cart, /api/data, /api/products/{productId}, /api/recommendations, CartService calls, ProductCatalogService, RecommendationService, AdService) show 0 error-status spans, and its checkout errors coincide with the checkout pod becoming unavailable.

OOM or memory-limit termination of the checkout container is not supported: the recorded last termination reason is Error with exitCode 2, not OOMKilled, and no OOMKilled or Evicted evidence appears for the pod.

The small error counts on ad, fraud-detection and recommendation flagd.evaluation.v1.Service/EventStream spans are pre-existing background noise, not this incident: they are 1.03, 2.05 and 2.04 in the 45 minutes 15:14-15:59 that ends when the alert starts, comparable to the 3.0-3.05 seen over the later 48-minute query, and their pods are ready with 0 restarts.

Restore the checkout container image: either delete pod checkout-5dccddf8bb-9dn2q so ReplicaSet checkout-5dccddf8bb (template image ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-checkout) recreates it, or revert the pod's container image to the value recorded in its checkout-normal annotation; then confirm the checkout Service Endpoints list a ready address.

Investigate what rewrote the pod's container image to gcr.io/google-containers/pause:latest (the pod carries a checkout-normal annotation holding the original image, and the kubelet logged 'Container checkout definition changed' seven times), since the change-history integration is unavailable in this Run and the acting component cannot be identified from the evidence collected.
Give checkout more than one replica so a single pod-level fault stops taking the whole checkout service out of the Endpoints list, as happened with replicas=1 and unavailableReplicas=1.

gaps: No trace-level detail exists for the failure interval: the newest Jaeger data returned for these queries is 15:52:47 (source_start_at 15:52:44), i.e. before the first 'Container checkout definition changed' event at 15:58:44, so the exact gRPC status code and error text of the failing frontend PlaceOrder spans could not be read from traces.

The frontend application logs could not be used: a filtered log query on pod frontend-675fd7b5c5-gc9hg for 15:50-16:17 returned status no_data with 0 lines read, so the client-side error text (for example a connection-refused or gRPC UNAVAILABLE message) is unverified.

The checkout container returned no log lines for 15:55-16:17 at all (status no_data); logs cannot prove absence, so it is unverified whether the failing container wrote any diagnostic output. A filtered query for panic/error/refused patterns over 15:44-16:17 also returned no matching lines.

Prometheus kube-state-metrics series for kube_deployment_status_replicas_available{namespace="otel-demo",deployment="checkout"} and kube_pod_container_info{pod=~"checkout.*"} returned status no_data (no series), so availability and image digest could not be corroborated through KSM; the Deployment/ReplicaSet/Pod objects were used instead.
The change-history integration is not available in this Run, so who or what mutated the pod's container image, and when precisely, cannot be established.

Metric samples for these trace series end at 16:13:00, so the apparent return of frontend POST /api/checkout rates to 0 in the last samples is a data boundary, not verified recovery; the pod object still showed CrashLoopBackOff at ~16:18-16:19.
The frontend-proxy 'ingress' span carries a small non-zero error baseline (~0.0037-0.0148/s) before the incident, whose cause was not investigated.
Frontend pod startup/restart history before 15:22 is not covered by these checks; only the current pod state (ready, 0 restarts) was verified.
next_steps: Revert or recreate checkout-5dccddf8bb-9dn2q with the image from its checkout-normal annotation / ReplicaSet template and verify the checkout Endpoints object regains ready addresses.

Check control-plane audit logs or the change-history source (not integrated here) for the actor that patched pod checkout-5dccddf8bb-9dn2q spec.containers[0].image to gcr.io/google-containers/pause:latest around 15:58:44.
After recovery, confirm the frontend POST /api/checkout and grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder error spans return to 0 and that the RequestErrorRate alert clears.
Review whether checkout should run with more than one replica to avoid a single-pod outage.
